# CircuitGraft

> Circuit-aware safety recovery for domain-fine-tuned Cohere Tiny Aya models.
> CircuitGraft discovers a safety circuit and a domain circuit in the same
> head/MLP component space (612 components), measures their overlap (72 of 184
> components shared, Jaccard 0.243, stable across discovery sparsities), and
> grafts the alignment safety delta back into a drifted medical specialist
> while protecting shared components. Track 2b / Problem 6, Lexsi Labs
> Hackathon, November 2026. All numbers come from the tracked S9 bundle
> `results/s9/report-1794803399/summary.json` (status: partial, disclosed).

## Core results (machine-checkable in the bundle)

- Blunt edit (C-ΔΘ): HarmBench refusal 81.3% → 6.0%, MedMCQA −16.0 pts,
  MMLU −25.0 pts vs the drifted specialist. Destroys both behaviours.
- Protected graft (cg_project): 69.3% HarmBench refusal, 40.0% MedMCQA,
  beats the unprotected control (cg_uniform) on every measured axis
  (refusal 69.3 vs 66.7, DGR −57.1% vs −142.9%, false refusal 7.5% vs 13.8%).
- No method Pareto-dominates: WiSE-FT holds the safety corner
  (87.3% refusal, 96.4% DGR); RESTA keeps accuracy (39.3% MedMCQA) but
  refuses only 52.7%.
- G-drift gate: refusal axis FAILED (+2.3 pts, needed ≥ 15), domain axis
  PASSED (+8.0 pts). SRR is not quoted as evidence this run (2.3-pt
  denominator); DGR is interpretable (8-pt denominator).
- S8 attacks were NOT run; the attack table is intentionally empty.
- Overlap: 184 safety / 184 domain / 72 shared (45 heads + 27 MLPs);
  Jaccard 0.17-0.24 across k ∈ {0.05, 0.1, 0.2, 0.3}.

## Documents

- [README](README.md): project overview, results-at-a-glance, charts, real
  model transcripts, honesty section, artifact links.
- [Article](docs/ARTICLE.md): filled submission article; every number
  bundle-checkable.
- [Presentation playbook](docs/PRESENTATION.md): pitch script with true
  numbers and Q&A.
- [Preregistration](docs/PREREGISTRATION.md): hypotheses, metrics, 8-model ×
  11-benchmark matrix, decision rules; frozen at commit edee9eb before any
  Phase 4 experiment; §10 documents the MCQ rescoring amendment.
- [Experiment log](docs/EXPERIMENT_LOG.md): dated commands, outcomes,
  failures and fixes; the only place results are recorded.
- [Rescore disclosure](docs/RESCORE.md): the MCQ scoring fix
  (letter-gold bug) and the CPU rescore procedure.
- [Kaggle run book](docs/KAGGLE_RUN.md): single-notebook execution plan,
  core matrix, storage/milestone rules, resume playbook.
- [API notes](docs/API_NOTES.md): verified signatures of the installed
  SafeTune, CircuitKIT, AuditKIT, CuratorKIT versions.

## Evidence

- [S9 report bundle summary](results/s9/report-1794803399/summary.json):
  the single source for every number (models, overlap, gate, sources,
  partial reasons).
- [S9 tables](results/s9/report-1794803399/table_main.md): main recovery
  table as generated by `cg report`.
- [Overlap heatmap](results/s9/report-1794803399/circuit_overlap_heatmap.png):
  72 shared / 112 safety-only / 112 domain-only cells; plots the
  preregistered membership sets, not raw attribution scores.
- [Discover artifacts](https://huggingface.co/datasets/dubeydevansh/circuitgraft-circuits):
  published circuit discovery artifacts (scores, overlaps, circuit info).
- [Eval logs](https://huggingface.co/datasets/dubeydevansh/circuitgraft-eval-logs):
  published evaluation logs and per-item predictions.

## Live demo

- [Results dashboard Space](https://huggingface.co/spaces/dubeydevansh/circuitgraft):
  static Space rendering the tracked bundle client-side; no GPU, no model
  loading.

## Code

- Package: `src/circuitgraft/` (components, discover, graft, eval, report,
  publish, drift, attacks, data).
- CLI: `cg data | drift | audit | discover | baselines | graft | eval |
  attack | eval-attacks | report | publish`.
- README extras generator: `scripts/build_readme_extras.py` — regenerates
  the glance table, chat transcripts and charts from the artifacts.
- Tests: 299 passing; `bash scripts/run_all.sh --check` for env + config +
  pytest + ruff.
